create_replay_buffer: create a ReplayBuffer with capacity N to store and sample experience transitions for DQN training
push_transitions_to_buffer: push trajectory transitions into the ReplayBuffer using the push method for experience replay
sample_replay_buffer: sample n random transitions from the ReplayBuffer for training the DQN agent
run_ddqn_training: run the DQN training loop with config, environment factory, and agent factory to learn a policy
compute_ddqn_loss: compute the double DQN loss from sampled transitions using the learning and target models
